title: Handing over the office move
scenario: You've been running the move of Northgate Insurance's (fictional) support team to a new floor. You're going on two weeks' leave tomorrow, and Priya, a colleague, takes over. Write the handoff note she'll read first.
audience: Priya: an experienced project manager who knows the company but not this project.
purpose: Give her the status, what's decided, what's open and needs her, and who to talk to, so she can act on day one without calling you.

facts.text: The move is booked for Saturday 14 June.
Desks, network points and the floor plan are signed off by facilities.
The new phone handsets haven't been delivered; the supplier says 'by 10 June' but hasn't confirmed in writing.
Someone needs to decide by 9 June whether the support team works from home on Monday 16 June if the phones aren't ready. The support lead, Dan, prefers working from home.
Spend so far is $18,400 of the $25,000 budget.
Facilities: Grace. Phone supplier contact: Hollis Telecom, account rep Sam. Support lead: Dan.

required.label: Where things stand
required.guidance: Say the date (Saturday 14 June) and what's already signed off.

required.label: The open risk
required.guidance: Name the risk precisely: the phones aren't delivered, and the 10 June promise isn't confirmed in writing.

required.label: The decision she needs to make, and by when
required.guidance: Say what needs deciding (home working on 16 June if the phones aren't ready) and the deadline (9 June); mention Dan's preference.

required.label: Who to talk to
required.guidance: List the people and what each is for: Grace (facilities), Sam at Hollis Telecom (phones), Dan (support lead).

claims_to_avoid.why: The brief says delivery isn't confirmed in writing; a handoff that says it is hides the main risk.
The brief says the home-working decision is still open.

avoid.why: Priya wasn't there; say what was agreed.
Name the thing: she doesn't know this project's usual.

sections.label: Open risks and decisions
sections.hint: What could go wrong, and what needs deciding by when.

sections.label: Who's who
sections.hint: Names and what each is for.

reference.status: The move is on Saturday 14 June. Facilities (Grace) has signed off the desks, network points and floor plan.
reference.open: Main risk: the new phone handsets aren't here. Hollis Telecom says 'by 10 June' but hasn't confirmed in writing; please chase Sam for written confirmation. Decision needed by 9 June: if the phones won't be ready, does the support team work from home on Monday 16 June? Dan, the support lead, prefers that.
reference.people: Grace: facilities. Sam at Hollis Telecom: phones. Dan: support lead, owns the home-working preference.

review_status: Fictional practice brief, written and checked for internal consistency; not reviewed by an outside practitioner. Not real company guidance.
